notes_for_editor: Only the Forest Fire Lookout Association list and OpenStreetMap describe this tower; neither gives a build date, builder, height, staffing or access. The list name is Washburn (Bayview); the OpenStreetMap name is Washburn Lookout Tower, and its coordinates match the list. What Bayview refers to is unexplained in the sources read. Two WebSearch rounds found only directory entries and records for other towers (Iron River, Bayfield, Long Mile). The Wisconsin Historical Society record HI24653 is Iron River, not this tower. A Forest Service PDF named Longmile as a surviving Bayfield County tower; it is not established that this is the Bayview site, so it is not used. The Washburn city page was read but its county line did not match the grep and is not used. Budget: 2 WebSearch, about 6 page reads.
